annotations.title: Generate GovCon Sources Sought, RFI & FAR 19.502-2 Set-Aside Shaping Response

description: Analyze agency Sources Sought notices, Market Research RFIs, and Draft PWS/SOWs against a vendor's socioeconomic status (`8(a)`, `SDVOSB`, `HUBZone`, `WOSB/EDWOSB`, Small Business) and past performance to generate a persuasive FAR 19.502-2 Rule-of-Two set-aside justification, a 13 CFR 121.402 NAICS & SBA size standard shaping analysis, a requirement-by-requirement capability alignment matrix, Contracting Officer / OSDBU acquisition-shaping recommendations, and a ready-to-submit Sources Sought / RFI response narrative. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive capture shaping generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `sources_sought_or_rfi_notice_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters and `vendor_capability_and_socioeconomic_profile` accepts 20 to 35,000 characters). Use this tool during pre-RFP Market Research / Sources Sought / RFI phases to persuade the Contracting Officer to set aside an upcoming procurement for small business; use `match_capability_statement` instead for Gate-1 Bid/No-Bid Pwin scoring on an already-released RFP, or `generate_rfp_response` to draft final RFP proposal volumes.

sources_sought_or_rfi_notice_text.description: Full text of the agency Sources Sought notice, Market Research RFI, SSN capability questions, or Draft PWS/SOW (20 to 45,000 characters).

target_set_aside_preference.description: Preferred FAR Part 19 set-aside pathway to justify to the Contracting Officer and OSDBU ('8a_Sole_Source_or_Competitive', 'SDVOSB_Set_Aside', 'HUBZone_Set_Aside', 'WOSB_EDWOSB_Set_Aside', 'Total_Small_Business_Rule_of_Two', or 'Auto_Recommend').

vendor_capability_and_socioeconomic_prof.description: Vendor socioeconomic designations (8(a), SDVOSB, HUBZone, WOSB/EDWOSB, Small Business), UEI/CAGE, GSA MAS / GWAC contract vehicles, facility clearances, and past performance (20 to 35,000 characters).

name: generate_sources_sought_response

contracting_officer_shaping_questions_an.description: Strategic acquisition-shaping recommendations for the Contracting Officer and OSDBU.

naics_psc_and_size_standard_shaping_anal.description: 13 CFR 121.402 NAICS code and SBA size standard shaping analysis.

ready_to_submit_sources_sought_response_.description: Complete, paste-ready Sources Sought / RFI response narrative.

recommended_acquisition_strategy_and_set.description: Recommended contract vehicle (GSA MAS, 8(a) STARS III, VETS 2, Polaris, Open Market) and FAR Part 19 set-aside determination.

requirement_capability_alignment_matrix.description: Requirement-by-requirement alignment table mapping agency RFI tasks to prime capabilities and 13 CFR 125.6 compliance.

rule_of_two_and_far_19_502_justification.description: Formal FAR 19.502-2 Rule-of-Two and FAR Part 10 market research justification.

set_aside_shaping_confidence_score.description: 0-100 score indicating the strength of the vendor's Rule-of-Two / set-aside shaping case.

title: Generate GovCon Sources Sought, RFI & FAR 19.502-2 Set-Aside Shaping Response
